notes: προσκαρτερήσομεν takes *will continue stedfastly* whole, headed on *continue*, which glosses the lexeme's own persistence sense; the unit's appeal to an intensive προσ- is loose, since *stedfastly* answers to the καρτερ- root rather than to the preverb, but the head is unaffected — *continue* is not a generic support verb, so rule 91's complement-head contrast does not apply.

The verse writes rule 21's two arms side by side: τῇ προσευχῇ → *in prayer* leaves the first article `unrepresented` with the case preposition on the noun, while τῇ διακονίᾳ → *in the ministry* gives *in the* to the second article, headed on *the*.
